title: windowed editor capture needs explicit DISPLAY provisioning
body: The documented windowed AppFlow witness exited 255 before channel startup because DISPLAY was unset; the lane had to export DISPLAY=:0 and unset WAYLAND_DISPLAY. The capture launcher should validate or provision the supported X11 display itself.

title: AppFlow materials collection lacks a readable view noun contract
body: EditorLayers_materials is present in the generated view catalogue but has no readable Data action, so the witness needed a hand-added top-level appflow.read materials projection to show the eight slot/name rows. Collection-shaped view data needs a generated read contract.

title: stored look-dev hull requires hand-authored affine placement
body: The look-dev stored hull fixture had no declarative world transform or provider-role mapping: the lane had to hand-author the hull-only stored role and 64-cell-to-world affine scale in BodyInstances so the valid bake entered the camera frame.
